description_en: Call the ListFlashSmsSettings operation to retrieve the flash SMS configurations for a specified skill group

kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-flash-sms-settings --skill-group-name '闪信测试技能组' --skill-group-id-list skillgroup1@ccc-test --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --instance-id ccc-test --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListFlashSmsSettings

parameters.help_en: The name of the skill group

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value ranges from 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The value ranges from 1 to 100
parameters.name: page_size
